Your bathroom lighting does more than just help you see 💡

Creating ambient or feature lighting can completely change how your bathroom feels, from bright in the morning to a relaxing space at night.

We love when bathrooms use LED panels or sconces for ambient lighting. But it's accent lighting that helps to add personality. Whether with backlit mirrors, under-vanity LED strips or lighting around alcoves, it can really highlight your bathroom’s best features.

Layering these types of lighting means you can tailor your bathroom to every mood and moment.

Designing a small bathroom? Let’s make it feel bigger ✨

By adding a floating vanity unit you can open up the floor and make everything feel lighter. While larger tiles means fewer grout lines as it tricks the eye and makes the space feel more open.

Choosing a walk-in shower with a clear screen rather than a shower over a bath keeps everything seamless and spacious.

Remember, it’s not about the size of your bathroom, it’s about how you design it.
